headlines.title: NBC News speaks with Palestinian in West Bank whose home is surrounded by Israeli settlers
headlines.description: Human rights groups say Israeli settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank has surged. NBC News' Richard Engel visits one village in the middle of the attacks, speaking with a man who says his house is surrounded by settlers.

headlines.title: Andy Ogles defeated in Tennessee House GOP primary, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles lost despite having President Trump’s endorsement, NBC News projects. Former state Agriculture Commissioner Charlie Hatcher will be the GOP nominee.

headlines.title: Marsha Blackburn wins GOP primary for Tennessee governor, NBC News projects
headlines.description: Sen. Marsha Blackburn, a longtime Trump ally, defeated Rep. John Rose for the nomination, NBC News projects, after the president decided not to endorse in the race.

headlines.title: Student kills 6 at school after shooting grandparents in Thailand
headlines.description: ]At least one teacher was killed and four other people injured by a student who opened fire at a school in Thailand on Friday before killing himself, authorities said.

headlines.title: Trump’s new executive orders restrict birthright citizenship
headlines.description: After his defeat at the Supreme Court, President Trump unveiled executive orders with narrower restrictions on birthright citizenship. The move is expected to face legal challenges. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak expands to 27 states
headlines.description: The FDA says they’ve now found the source of that jalapeño pepper recall linked to Chipotle. It does not appear the peppers in question went to grocery stores, but they did go to wholesalers, restaurants and food service companies. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has the story.

headlines.title: Serial arson suspect in Spokane charged with igniting multiple fires
headlines.description: The man authorities say started the most destructive fire in Spokane history is now charged with starting four other fires since July of last year. 37-year-old Aaron Farinacci appeared remotely in court late today but did not enter a plea. NBC News’ Morgan Chesky reports from inside the burn zone.

headlines.title: AI is looking for thousands of people to dig trenches for internet cables
headlines.description: The AI-powered growth of data centers is driving demand for human workers to lay new fiber optic cables from coast to coast.

headlines.title: Ohio Rep. Max Miller faces a growing number of calls to resign from fellow Republicans
headlines.description: Miller, who is running for re-election, has denied abusing his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, who is the daughter of Sen. Bernie Moreno of Ohio.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Rep. Andy Ogles loses his Republican primary in Tennessee
headlines.description: Rep. Andy Ogles of Tennessee has lost his Republican primary, NBC News projects, falling to a former state official in a primary season that has seen an unusually high number of incumbents lose renomination.
